entry.title: New: dsh-plugin-advisor
entry.summary: Quality-aware in-agent plugin discovery: a find_dsh_plugins tool that ranks the whole dsh-plugin topic through a daily quality-scored index (installable manifest, curated listing, license, activity) merged with a live gh search — zero LLM API cost, risk flags and exact install commands in every result. Exact install spec: github:chengxiucdp/dsh-plugin-advisor. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
